description: Provider-neutral function tool definitions for AgentTerminal 0.5.x.

tools.name: agent_terminal_open
tools.description: Create a visible AgentTerminal window, tab, or split pane with a PowerShell, CMD, WSL, or Conda profile. Every live session name must be unique.

session.description: Unique session name used by later run, ping, and stop calls.

profile.description: Execution profile used by session-mode commands.

condaEnv.description: Conda environment name; valid only for the conda profile. Defaults to base.

distro.description: WSL distribution name; valid only for the wsl profile.

tools.name: agent_terminal_run
tools.description: Run a command in a named visible AgentTerminal session, using its declared profile or an explicit override. This can perform arbitrary actions as the current user; obtain approval when consequential.

command.description: One command string for session, powershell, cmd, or wsl mode.

background.description: Start a supervised background job and return immediately. Use for servers, monitors, downloads, and other long-running commands.

tools.name: agent_terminal_job
tools.description: Inspect logs or status, or stop the single supervised background job in an AgentTerminal session.

tools.name: agent_terminal_ping
tools.description: Check whether a named AgentTerminal session is reachable.

tools.name: agent_terminal_stop
tools.description: Stop one named AgentTerminal session without stopping other tabs or panes.
